**Email outreach (Instantly) performance to date:**
• 7,400 total emails sent to vetted B2B contacts  
• 3.23 percent reply rate  
• 7 active opportunities generated to date  

In addition to the above, over **387 manual, personalized B2B outreaches and follow-ups** were completed directly by me. These were highly targeted to industry decision-makers and gatekeepers.

The results from this type of outreach are difficult to time-stamp because partnership conversations in this industry often take longer to mature, and in many cases the specific contacts approached were simply not interested in partnerships at this time.

This is not unusual in this segment, but it does matter when evaluating ongoing effort versus return.

Going forward, I want to be very transparent about scope and effectiveness.

Manual outreach does appear to be more effective than some of the automated methods we tested. However, continuing high-volume manual outreach on an ongoing basis was not part of the original scope and becomes an effort that can cost both parties time and money if it is not tightly monitored or producing traction.

I do not want to create an ongoing effort that drains resources without results, especially when we all knew this approach required testing.

That said, I will continue to support this relationship. I will:
• Continue making connections daily  
• Continue LinkedIn outreach  
• Continue telling all new Luxora and New Era Intel clients that your course is necessary for consistent, sustainable profitability  
• Advocate for AIA and YT whenever appropriate within our ecosystem  

If we choose to continue manual follow-up beyond what is already in motion, that effort will need to be mutually monitored and clearly defined, particularly if we decide not to move forward with an ongoing hourly retainer.

I am happy to walk through all of this live and will give you a call shortly so we can finalize the February cleanup and discuss the best path forward for AmSpa funding.

Thanks again, and I appreciate the partnership and collaboration here.

Bethany
